response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded, AI) and languages (C, C++, D, JavaScript, Python, etc.), but lacks direct experience with the specific embedded networking, security, and LAN-switch firmware requirements outlined in the job description. Their recent roles focus heavily on high-level web and AI infrastructure, with no demonstrated work in kernel modification, MACsec, 802.1X, or embedded device security. Native Japanese proficiency is also unconfirmed.
strengths: Strong C/C++ and embedded systems background (e.g., work with Dlang, LabWindows/CVI)
Proven ability to learn and adapt to new technologies rapidly
Experience with system-level programming and hardware interaction
concerns: No clear experience with Linux kernel modification, security features (MACsec, 802.1X), or embedded networking firmware
Lacks recent involvement in network switch or embedded device development as per job requirements
Japanese language proficiency not verified on resume (only English, Romanian, and basic German listed)
